# Protection Paladin — what the bots run

**Recommendation (what the bots run).** Build (levels 10-60), 11/33/7 — no respec, one build from level 10 to 60. The decision loop walks 93 rules in ascending priority and executes the first whose condition is true. The party fixtures place this spec on level 51 (1 member), level 60 (8 members). [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/paladin/protection/talents.yaml`, `rotation.yaml`]

**Measured in round 155** (amp-6's per-spec table). **GOOD** — 118% of the human spec median (258 vs 217.7 boss DPS over 58 boss fights); threat held, dtps 148 [measured].

**This page is the bots' half.** It records what our party bots actually run for this spec — the level-60 build and the level-by-level order, the rule firing order the decision loop walks, the kit bands, the round-155 measurement and the recorded deviations. The hand-written guide for this spec is [protection.md](./protection.md).

## How the bots play it

On every decision tick the loop walks the rules in ascending `priority`, executes the first one whose condition is true and skips the rest of that tick. The groups below are a reading aid; the priority numbers are the real order. Level is the rule's own `level_min` — the first level it can fire.

### Single target

- **85 — Holy Strike** (`PP14-holy-strike`) — level 4+ · intent `filler` · spell 679
  - **When:** the party has a living member; the target is hostile; in melee range; Holy Strike is off cooldown; the resident does not have Divine Protection; the resident does not have Divine Protection; at least 5 mana.
  - **Why:** Turtle content, quest-taught at 4 (RequiredRaces 589 covers all three paladin races); 5 mana, 6 s categoryRecoveryTime.

## Situational notes from the rule notes

Every sentence below is copied from a rule's own note (the rule id is in front of it) and mentions a situation the rule exists for. Rest, food and drink rules are left out here; their items are in the band table above.

- **PP00u-wizard-oil — Apply Brilliant Wizard Oil:** The spec's own guide page names it (line 271); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **PP00u-superior-defense — Use Elixir of Superior Defense:** HO-TKB-PLAY-205 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator for the owner full-kit order 2026-10-18: buff food, elixirs, oils and stones in use): Elixir of Superior Defense (item 13445, required level 43), elixir or potion (aura 11348 while it lasts), out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and the buff or enchant is missing (or under 5 min for an enchant), so it is also re-applied after a death or a swap. The spec's own guide page names it (line 273); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **PP00u-free-action-rattlegore — Use Free Action Potion:** Rattlegore (11622) stuns; the Scholomance guide: pop a Free Action Potion 5-10 s into the fight so his stun misses (aura 6615, mechanic 11 immunity).
- **PP00u-greater-stoneshield-boss — Use Greater Stoneshield Potion:** HO-TKB-PLAY-218 (PIONEER FIX, endgame specs programme; kit sync ruling 2026-10-18: the kit is generated from the rules, so an item the guide wants needs a rule): Greater Stoneshield Potion (item 13455, required level 46, aura 17540 Greater Stoneshield, armour) on a boss once the tank has threat. No boss-burst list exists for our dungeons, so the trigger is the boss flag with threat opened and health at 60 per cent or more: a proxy, open question.
- **PP00u-tea — Use Nordanaar Herbal Tea:** Restores 525 health and 810 mana (spell 19398, instant) and shares its 120 s category 1172 with the Dark and Demonic Runes; the guide names it as the mana cooldown beside the potions.
- **PP00u-fortitude — Use Elixir of Fortitude:** Same shape as the HO-205 elixir and food rules: out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, the item in the bags and ready, and its aura 3593 missing (so again after a death).
- **PP00u-greater-arcane — Use Greater Arcane Elixir:** Same shape as the HO-205 elixir and food rules: out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, the item in the bags and ready, and its aura 17539 missing (so again after a death).
- **PP00u-dreamshard — Use Dreamshard Elixir:** Same shape as the HO-205 elixir and food rules: out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, the item in the bags and ready, and its aura 45427 missing (so again after a death).
- **PP00u-mongoose — Use Elixir of the Mongoose:** Same shape as the HO-205 elixir and food rules: out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, the item in the bags and ready, and its aura 17538 missing (so again after a death).
- **PP00f-hand-of-freedom — Hand of Freedom:** Hand of Freedom 1044 (level 18, no mana cost, 24 s recoveryTime, 6 s) is an immunity to mechanics 7 (root) and 11 (snare) (EffectMiscValue1 7, EffectMiscValue2 11, aura 77; spell_template). Self-cast on the paladin tank when a root or snare from the Scholomance b05 kits is on it: Web Explosion 15474 (Necrofiend 11551, mechanic 7), Mind Flay 17165 (Neophyte 10470 and Acolyte 10471, mechanic 11) or Cripple 11443 (Acolyte, EffectMechanic1 11); each aura carries its spell id.
- **PP01-righteous-fury — Righteous Fury:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568, OQ-2569): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). Once the eat rule stops re-pushing into its own aura, nothing else holds a self-defensive, a form, an aura or a mana cooldown back while seated, and any cast stands the resident up (Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0).
- **PP02s-sanctity-aura — Sanctity Aura:** HO-TKB-PLAY-223 (protection 11/33/7 takes Sanctity Aura 1/1 at level 53 in 211's order and the file never cast it): "Sanctity Aura (11 Holy points) is effectively mandatory ... about 9 per cent of your total threat ('Sanctity is king')", "Righteous Fury and Sanctity Aura always on" (protection.md L3, L22, L92, L148). The aura (spell 20218, +holy damage for party members in range, tkbplay-223.result.txt) replaces Retribution Aura and Devotion Aura as the tank's aura from 53: PP02 and PP01a below carry `not aura_self(20218)` so the three aura rules cannot swap each other (an aura of one paladin excludes the others).
- **PP02-retribution-aura — Retribution Aura:** DECISION 77 (owner, 2026-09-30, OQ-2592): the tank runs Retribution Aura, as the archive's level 20-29 dungeon tank does, instead of Devotion Aura; below 16 (Retribution Aura not yet trained) the tank runs no aura, since the rule format has no level cap to hand the slot to Devotion safely. Earlier note, kept for the record: Free, no duration; armour for the party and the tank, and the aura slot has no competitor for this spec.
- **PP01a-devotion-aura — Devotion Aura:** HO-TKB-PLAY-031 (orchestrator, round-47 delta-0 split): Devotion Aura (465, spellLevel 1, no mana) below the level where Retribution Aura exists. The guide: "Blessing of Might and Devotion Aura before you pull.
- **PP03-blessing-of-sanctuary — Blessing of Sanctuary:** HO-TKB-PLAY-132 (v27): Sanctuary goes on the paladin tank itself (`target: self`; "Blessing of Sanctuary if you are Prot", paladin/leveling.md L159); on party_missing it would replace PP03s's Salvation on the other members. HO-TKB-PLAY-025 (vocabulary v8, HO-P1-LOOP-016): `target: party_missing`: the paladin himself first (at 0 yd, "Blessing of Sanctuary if you are Prot", leveling.md L159), then every member lacking it, instead of the lowest-health member. r35: on Aldwin himself 49-60 per cent of combat, on the rest of party B 59-98.
- **PP03w-blessing-of-wisdom-self — Blessing of Wisdom:** HO-TKB-PLAY-117 (decision 177): the tank's buffs are "Retribution Aura, Righteous Fury, Blessing of Wisdom; Blessing of Sanctuary if you are Prot" (guide/classes/paladin/leveling.md L159, L282): a retribution paladin in the tank role has no Sanctuary, so it keeps Wisdom on itself; a protection paladin keeps Sanctuary (PP03), which this rule does not go over.
- **PP03s-blessing-of-salvation — Blessing of Salvation:** HO-TKB-PLAY-132 (p4-pioneer decision 189 (d): pioneer parties are a warrior or druid tank and a ret paladin, and the DPS threat without Salvation is the likeliest wipe cause data cannot fix; p1-loop v27 HO-P1-LOOP-036): Blessing of Salvation on every member but the paladin itself and the party tank (`target: party_missing_others`), out of combat; it cuts their threat by 30 per cent, which a tank must never carry. One paladin's blessings replace each other on a member, so Might goes on the tank only and this file's own Wisdom stays on the paladin.
- **PP03a-seal-of-wisdom — Seal of Wisdom:** HO-TKB-PLAY-154 (orchestrator, round-135 late read item 6: RFK party B's paladin tank Ambrel, no crowd control in the party, 0 of 6 runs past the second boss): on trash too, Seal of Wisdom only where threat is not contested. With three or more mobs engaged on the party within 10 yd, or the tank's own target hitting someone else, and at 40 per cent mana or more, PP04 re-seals Seal of Righteousness after each Judgement instead, the boss seal of 153 ("Use SoR if your mana lasts from pull to pull", guide/classes/paladin/leveling.md L97; Righteousness adds holy damage, raised by Righteous Fury, to every swing and to its Judgement, Wisdom adds none).
- **PP03p-seal-of-wisdom-before-the-pull — Seal of Wisdom:** HO-TKB-PLAY-117 (decision 177): the pull: "pre-cast Seal of Wisdom (trash) or Seal of Righteousness (boss)" and the trash routine "prebuff Seal of Wisdom" (guide/classes/paladin/leveling.md L160, L282). Above PP03a-seal-before-the-pull, which keeps Seal of Righteousness for a boss pull (party.pull_is_boss) and below 18, where Seal of Wisdom does not exist.
- **PP03a-seal-before-the-pull — Seal of Righteousness:** HO-TKB-PLAY-031 (orchestrator, round-47 delta-0 split): the seal goes up BEFORE the first swing. The guide: "Keep a seal up ...
- **PP04-seal-of-righteousness — Seal of Righteousness:** The seal this spec keeps: in the starting kit, 20 mana, 30 s, and it adds holy damage to every swing, which is threat. Re-sealed in combat only.
- **PP05-lay-on-hands — Lay on Hands:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568, OQ-2569): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). Once the eat rule stops re-pushing into its own aura, nothing else holds a self-defensive, a form, an aura or a mana cooldown back while seated, and any cast stands the resident up (Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0).
- **PP06-divine-shield — Divine Shield:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568, OQ-2569): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). Once the eat rule stops re-pushing into its own aura, nothing else holds a self-defensive, a form, an aura or a mana cooldown back while seated, and any cast stands the resident up (Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0).
- **PP07-divine-protection — Divine Protection:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568, OQ-2569): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). Once the eat rule stops re-pushing into its own aura, nothing else holds a self-defensive, a form, an aura or a mana cooldown back while seated, and any cast stands the resident up (Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0).
- **PP14-holy-strike — Holy Strike:** At the pin Divine Protection (498 rank 1, 5573 rank 2) lays SPELL_AURA_MOD_PACIFY (aura 25) as its first effect, so every melee strike pushed while it is up fails SPELL_FAILED_PACIFIED. In round thirty-four all 43 PACIFIED failures of Aldwin (40 Holy Strike, 3 Crusader Strike; 34 in round thirty-three) fell inside the bot's own Divine Protection (r34-cast-audit.txt); with the guard the ladder falls through to what is still castable (Judgement, Flash of Light, the heals below).
- **PP11-judgement — Judgement:** 10 s recoveryTime, and it consumes the seal above it, so a judgement costs its own price plus a re-seal. Neither half is free and the earlier note said the first half was: at the pin Judgement (20271) carries manaCost 0 and manaCostPercentage 6, and Spell::CalculatePowerCost adds that share of BASE mana at every level, so at level 25 it is 6 per cent of a paladin's 552 base, about 33 mana, and the re-seal is 20 for Seal of Righteousness or 65 for Seal of Wisdom.
- **PP15m-cleanse-must — Cleanse:** HO-TKB-PLAY-186 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator: owner ruling, meaningful dispels not random; decision 214's principle): the MUST-REMOVE half. amp-5's DB study (harmful player debuffs per dungeon, 2026-10-16: 41 of about 120 removable debuffs are must-remove: control, charm, silence, fear, heal and cast slows, the heavy damage-over-time curses and diseases) names the ids, and this rule removes them by id, high in the ladder so it reacts fast, reading the heal target today (the afflicted member only when it is the heal target; p4-group's view will aim it). The generic cleanse further down the file is now 'when free': below every heal rule and behind a 50 per cent mana floor, so a trivial debuff never costs a heal or the mana for one.
- **PP11s-judgement-solo — Judgement:** In a party PP11-judgement (priority 86) takes the tick first.
- **PP11b-bulwark-boss-pull — Bulwark of the Righteous:** HO-TKB-PLAY-170 (decision 207, owner: pioneers play proper role specs from level 50; the orchestrator: pre-pull defensives on boss pulls only where a guide says so). The protection-tank guide lists Bulwark of the Righteous at priority 4: "boss pull when DPS open early, otherwise hold as -30% damage cooldown" (docs/research/tkb/play/playbooks-resolved/paladin/protection-tank.yaml L300-L302).
- **PP12c-hammer-of-justice-caster — Hammer of Justice:** HO-TKB-PLAY-025 (vocabulary v8, HO-P1-LOOP-016): also on a runner (target.fleeing): "Hand of Reckoning or Hammer of Justice on a runner" (leveling.md L161, dungeon tanking 20-29). A stun used as the interrupt: 30 mana, 60 s categoryRecoveryTime, so it is spent on a cast, not on cooldown.
- **PP08b-hammer-of-justice-second — Hammer of Justice:** If a second one joins, Hammer of Justice it and kill the first." The existing rule above stuns the kill target when it casts or flees; this one stuns the second mob, 30 mana, 60 s cooldown (so it cannot repeat on a stun-immune mob).
- **PP12-hammer-of-justice — Hammer of Justice:** HO-TKB-PLAY-025 (vocabulary v8, HO-P1-LOOP-016): also on a runner (target.fleeing): "Hand of Reckoning or Hammer of Justice on a runner" (leveling.md L161, dungeon tanking 20-29). A stun used as the interrupt: 30 mana, 60 s categoryRecoveryTime, so it is spent on a cast, not on cooldown.
- **PP14b-exorcism — Exorcism:** HO-TKB-PLAY-181 (PIONEER FIX, amp-3 audit r2, orchestrator): Exorcism on an Undead or Demon target, after the strikes. The protection file had no rule for it while the retribution file casts it (PR08a, 241 casts in the round 148 data, d-20261016T093000Z) and our dungeons have Undead and Demon trash.
- **PP15-cleanse — Cleanse:** Item-taught at 30, free at the pin, three dispel effects: magic (1), disease (3) and poison (4). HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435).
- **PP16-purify — Purify:** Item-taught at 6, free, disease and poison only; below PP15 which the loop reaches first once Cleanse is known. HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435).
- **PP18-holy-light — Holy Light:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568, OQ-2569): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). Once the eat rule stops re-pushing into its own aura, nothing else holds a self-defensive, a form, an aura or a mana cooldown back while seated, and any cast stands the resident up (Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0).
- **PP17-flash-of-light — Flash of Light:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568, OQ-2569): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). Once the eat rule stops re-pushing into its own aura, nothing else holds a self-defensive, a form, an aura or a mana cooldown back while seated, and any cast stands the resident up (Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0).

## What the bots do not do (from the rule notes)

Sentences from the rules' notes that say what is deliberately not implemented, or that name an open question.

- **PP00u-greater-stoneshield-boss:** No boss-burst list exists for our dungeons, so the trigger is the boss flag with threat opened and health at 60 per cent or more: a proxy, open question.
- **PP02s-sanctity-aura:** Not built: 'Retribution Aura if another paladin has Sanctity' (L22, L148) needs a way to read another paladin's aura; open question.
